statement: Between 2026-11-05 and 2026-12-04 inclusive, CISA adds at least one SonicWall Global Management System (GMS) vulnerability to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.
resolution: The CISA KEV catalog JSON carries an entry with vendorProject SonicWall and a product field naming GMS or Global Management System whose dateAdded is between 2026-11-05 and 2026-12-04 inclusive.
failure_condition: No SonicWall GMS vulnerability is added to the KEV catalog with a dateAdded value between 2026-11-05 and 2026-12-04 inclusive.

statement: Between 2026-11-05 and 2026-12-04 inclusive, CISA adds at least one Android or Pixel vulnerability (KEV vendorProject Android, or Google with product Android or Pixel) to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.
resolution: The CISA KEV catalog JSON carries an entry whose vendorProject is Android, or whose vendorProject is Google with product Android or Pixel, with dateAdded between 2026-11-05 and 2026-12-04 inclusive.
failure_condition: No Android or Pixel vulnerability is added to the KEV catalog with a dateAdded value between 2026-11-05 and 2026-12-04 inclusive.

statement: The front-month NYMEX WTI crude oil futures contract settles below 80.00 USD per barrel on 2026-12-31. Reference: 91.85 USD on the packet date, 2026-11-04.
resolution: The CME Group official daily settlement price for the front-month NYMEX WTI crude oil futures contract on 2026-12-31 is strictly below 80.00 USD per barrel. Reference level at seal: 91.85 on 2026-11-04.
failure_condition: The front-month WTI settlement price on 2026-12-31 is 80.00 USD per barrel or higher.

statement: The 10-year US Treasury constant maturity yield (FRED series DGS10) for 2026-12-31 is below 4.75 percent. Reference: 4.91 percent on the packet date, 2026-11-04.
resolution: The FRED DGS10 observation dated 2026-12-31 is strictly below 4.75. Reference level at seal: 4.91 percent on 2026-11-04. If no observation exists for that date, the last prior observation governs.
failure_condition: The DGS10 observation for 2026-12-31 is 4.75 percent or higher.

statement: Between 2027-01-03 and 2027-04-30 inclusive, President Trump vetoes at least one bill or joint resolution passed by the 120th Congress.
resolution: The US Senate Vetoes by President page or Congress.gov records a presidential veto (regular or pocket) of a 120th Congress measure dated between 2027-01-03 and 2027-04-30 inclusive.
failure_condition: No veto of any 120th Congress measure is issued with a date between 2027-01-03 and 2027-04-30 inclusive.

statement: Between 2026-11-05 and 2027-01-15 inclusive, the Knesset approves a new Israeli government in a vote of confidence and that government is sworn in.
resolution: A Knesset vote of confidence approves a new government, and the government is sworn in, on a date between 2026-11-05 and 2027-01-15 inclusive, as reported by at least two of Reuters, AP, AFP, Times of Israel.
failure_condition: No new Israeli government wins a Knesset confidence vote and is sworn in between 2026-11-05 and 2027-01-15 inclusive.

statement: In the South African municipal elections held 2026-11-04, the ANC overall national share of votes in the final IEC results is below 40.0 percent.
resolution: The Electoral Commission of South Africa final results show the ANC with an overall national vote share strictly below 40.0 percent, as published on the IEC results portal or reported by two of Reuters, AP, BBC, News24.
failure_condition: The ANC overall national vote share in the final IEC results is 40.0 percent or higher.

statement: Between 2026-11-05 and 2026-12-04 inclusive, a single Russian missile or drone strike on Ukraine kills 20 or more people according to the Ukrainian official death toll.
resolution: Ukrainian national or regional authorities state a death toll of 20 or more from one Russian strike that occurred between 2026-11-05 and 2026-12-04 inclusive, as reported by at least two of Reuters, AP, AFP, BBC.
failure_condition: No single Russian strike occurring between 2026-11-05 and 2026-12-04 reaches an official Ukrainian death toll of 20 by the deadline.

statement: Between 2026-11-05 and 2026-12-31 inclusive, US forces carry out at least one kinetic strike on a target inside Iranian territory that the US government publicly confirms.
resolution: An official statement from the Pentagon, CENTCOM or the White House confirms a US strike on a target on Iranian soil conducted between 2026-11-05 and 2026-12-31 inclusive.
failure_condition: US forces conduct no publicly confirmed strike on Iranian territory between 2026-11-05 and 2026-12-31 inclusive.

statement: Between 2026-11-05 and 2026-12-18 inclusive, OFAC announces a sanctions designation, or the US Department of Justice files charges or a forfeiture action, that explicitly references the 6.3 billion USD Binance crypto theft disclosed on 2026-11-03.
resolution: An OFAC Recent Actions entry or Treasury press release, or a DOJ press release or court filing, dated between 2026-11-05 and 2026-12-18 inclusive, explicitly names Binance and the roughly 6.3 billion USD theft.
failure_condition: No OFAC designation and no DOJ charge or forfeiture filing dated between 2026-11-05 and 2026-12-18 references the Binance theft.
